const validation = $json.fetchValidation;

return {
  json: {
    scannedUrl: $json.scannedUrl,
    scanCompletedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    scanStatus: "failed",
    failureStage: "fetch",
    failureReason: validation.failureReason,
    httpStatusCode: validation.statusCode,
    title: null,
    pageChecks: [],
    pageReviewCount: null,
    aiAnalysis: null,
    aiStatus: "not_checked",
    aiFailureReason: "AI analysis was skipped because the initial page could not be scanned.",
    linkSummary: {
      status: "not_checked",
      reason: "The initial page could not be scanned.",
      checked: 0,
      passed: 0,
      broken: 0,
      needsReview: 0,
      unverified: 0
    },
    linkResults: [],
    scope: {
      pageChecks: "Not performed because the initial fetch failed validation.",
      linkChecks: "Not performed.",
      wholeWebsiteScanned: false
    },
    checksNotPerformed: [
      "Page title, meta description, and H1 checks",
      "AI content summary",
      "Broken links",
      "Visual layout",
      "Page speed",
      "Forms and booking functionality"
    ]
  }
};
